title: Multiplication by a C^∞ function maps D^k(U) into D^k(U)
statement: For all P, k ∈ ℕ, every U ⊆ ℝ^P, every test form φ ∈ D^k(U) (TestFormOn U k: φ is C^∞, has compact support and tsupport φ ⊆ U) and every C^∞ function ψ : ℝ^P → ℝ, there is a test form η ∈ D^k(U) with η(x) = ψ(x)·φ(x) for every x ∈ ℝ^P.
lean_statement: ∀ (P k : ℕ) (U : Set (Eucl P)) (φ : TestFormOn U k) (ψ : Eucl P → ℝ), ContDiff ℝ ((⊤ : ℕ∞) : WithTop ℕ∞) ψ → ∃ η : TestFormOn U k, ∀ x, (η : DifferentialForm (Eucl P) k) x = ψ x • (φ : DifferentialForm (Eucl P) k) x
